question: Return the name of the discount that corresponds to the most rental history records.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "discounts" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "nm" AS "nm", "mc" AS "mc" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rental_history" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "customer_id" AS "customer_id", "discount_id" AS "discount_id", "vehicles_id" AS "vehicles_id", "total_hours" AS "total_hours" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT d.nm AS discount_name, cnt AS rental_history_count
FROM (
  SELECT discount_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental_history
  GROUP BY discount_id
) rh
JOIN discounts d ON d.id = rh.discount_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC, d.nm ASC
LIMIT 1;
S:
# Compute the discount name with the highest number of rental history records
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT d.nm AS discount_name, cnt AS rental_history_count
FROM (
  SELECT discount_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental_history
  GROUP BY discount_id
) rh
JOIN discounts d ON d.id = rh.discount_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC, d.nm ASC
LIMIT 1;
'''
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql)
